correctness.rationale: Every cardinality-two additive subgroup is \(\{0,v\}\) because the additive group of \(I_2\) has exponent two. Such a code fails to be ACD exactly when \(v\) is self-orthogonal. The multiplication table gives \(\langle v,v\rangle=(n_a+n_c)b\), proving the odd-parity criterion. Coordinate permutations preserve and are completely determined by the four coordinate multiplicities. Fixing Hamming distance \(d\), summing the \(j+1\) compositions of \(n_a+n_c=j\) over odd \(j\le d\) gives the two distance formulas, whose sums give the all-length totals. Exact exhaustive replay through length seven independently matches every formula.

value.rationale: The source devotes an explicit classification table to ACD codes over I2 but reaches only length five for the cardinality-two layer. The result closes that entire layer for all lengths, gives not just total counts but the complete Hamming-distance profile, and explains why every length admits maximum-distance examples. The formulas recover all published finite data exactly and turn a finite computational row into a transparent infinite classification.
